description: Flat metadata schema for individual EEG/ERP trial or epoch records from human visual-stimulus experiments, including stimulus timing, participant response, and recording context.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual record/trial/epoch within the dataset; should be stable and de-identified.

session_id.descr: Identifier for the recording session or visit for this subject.

run_id.descr: Identifier for the experimental run/block within the session.

trial_number.descr: Sequential trial number within the run or session, starting at 1.

block_number.descr: Experimental block number if the task is organized into blocks.

task_name.descr: Name of the task paradigm, e.g., visual oddball, face recognition, go/no-go.

stimulus_id.descr: Identifier for the specific stimulus presented on this trial.

stimulus_label.descr: Human-readable stimulus category or condition label, e.g., face, house, target, non-target.

stimulus_modality.descr: Stimulus modality; for this dataset typically 'visual'.

stimulus_file.descr: Filename, URI, or code for the stimulus asset used on this trial.

stimulus_category.descr: Higher-level category of the stimulus, if applicable.

stimulus_condition.descr: Experimental condition associated with the stimulus, e.g., attended/unattended, congruent/incongruent.

stimulus_duration_ms.descr: Duration of stimulus presentation in milliseconds (ms).

stimulus_onset_time_ms.descr: Time of stimulus onset relative to the session or trial clock in milliseconds.

stimulus_offset_time_ms.descr: Time of stimulus offset relative to the session or trial clock in milliseconds.

event_marker_code.descr: Trigger or event code sent to the EEG acquisition system for ERP alignment.

event_marker_time_ms.descr: Timestamp of the ERP-relevant event marker in milliseconds.

response_required.descr: Whether a behavioral response was required on this trial.

response_present.descr: Whether the participant made a response on this trial.

response_type.descr: Type of response, e.g., button press, key press, verbal response, none.

response_code.descr: Recorded response code or button identifier.

response_time_ms.descr: Reaction time from stimulus onset or target onset in milliseconds.

response_accuracy.descr: Accuracy of the response for this trial; suggested values include correct, incorrect, missed, false_alarm.

response_confidence.descr: Optional confidence rating reported by the participant; use a defined scale if available.

erp_latency_ms.descr: Latency of the ERP alignment point or component of interest in milliseconds, if annotated at record level.

erp_component_label.descr: ERP component label if available, e.g., P1, N170, N200, P300.

epoch_start_ms.descr: Start time of the extracted EEG epoch relative to the event marker in milliseconds.

epoch_end_ms.descr: End time of the extracted EEG epoch relative to the event marker in milliseconds.

baseline_start_ms.descr: Start of baseline correction window relative to the event marker in milliseconds.

baseline_end_ms.descr: End of baseline correction window relative to the event marker in milliseconds.

sampling_rate_hz.descr: EEG acquisition sampling rate in Hz.

channel_count.descr: Number of EEG channels recorded in this record's acquisition set.

electrode_montage.descr: EEG montage or electrode layout name, e.g., 10-20, 10-10, BioSemi64.

reference_type.descr: EEG reference scheme used, e.g., average reference, linked mastoids, Cz.

impedance_ohms_max.descr: Maximum electrode impedance in ohms observed during recording, if measured.

amplifier_model.descr: EEG amplifier or acquisition hardware model.

software_name.descr: Recording or stimulus presentation software name.

software_version.descr: Recording or stimulus presentation software version.

filter_low_cut_hz.descr: High-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz, if applied.

filter_high_cut_hz.descr: Low-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz, if applied.

notch_filter_hz.descr: Notch filter frequency in Hz, if applied (e.g., 50 or 60).

artifact_rejected.descr: Whether this record/trial was flagged or rejected due to artifact contamination.

artifact_type.descr: Artifact type(s) observed, e.g., blink, muscle, movement, electrode pop.

artifact_detection_method.descr: Method used to detect artifacts, e.g., manual inspection, ICA, amplitude threshold.

bad_channel_count.descr: Number of channels marked bad for this record or epoch.

baseline_corrected.descr: Whether baseline correction was applied to this epoch or trial.

normalized.descr: Whether the EEG data were normalized or z-scored before analysis.

manual_reviewed.descr: Whether the record was manually reviewed by an analyst.

review_status.descr: Outcome of manual review, e.g., accepted, rejected, uncertain.

participant_age_years.descr: Participant age in years at the time of recording.

participant_sex.descr: Participant sex as recorded, using study-defined categories.

handedness.descr: Participant handedness, e.g., right, left, ambidextrous.

vision_status.descr: Participant vision status, e.g., normal, corrected_to_normal, impaired.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent was obtained for the participant/session.

ethics_approval_id.descr: Institutional ethics or IRB approval identifier associated with the study.

deidentified.descr: Whether the record has been de-identified according to study policy.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to this record, such as unusual events, interruptions, or protocol deviations.
